implementation.behavior: Ordinary CARD play resolves the first fully equivalent matching live hand entry deterministically. All card-select paths retain strict ambiguity rejection.

root_cause.summary: Real live hands can contain two entries identical across every CardWire field, including uniqueId. Ordinary CARD lowering incorrectly assumed such identity was unique and failed closed before legal action execution.
root_cause.safety_reasoning: For ordinary play, fully matching entries serialize every CardInstance field and use the same semantic target; they are gameplay-equivalent. The deterministic first match still passes live Action::isValidAction. Single- and multi-card selection remain strict because positional subset identity can matter.
